candidate_universe: 20 unique canonical US grant documents from the frozen Boston Scientific and Stryker parent snapshots
fixed_query_contract: HT-B1/B2/B3 share the first query text and fixed query-prefix order
failure_rule: Failed queries remain in the denominator and receive zero known-link recall
unjudged_rule: Unlisted pairs remain unjudged and are never recoded as negatives
holdout_rule: The full Stryker Neurovascular company group is final holdout; no tuning or query reassignment after freeze
tuning: No method, query, cutoff, or split tuning after holdout declaration
